description: This file defines the LoadGrain class, which implements a grain for Orleans framework to perform load testing by generating and managing asynchronous ping requests, and collecting reports on success and failure counts.

classes.name: LoadGrain
classes.description: A grain class that manages load generation and reporting for ping operations within the Orleans framework.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Starts the load generation process with specified run count and concurrency.

methods.name: TryGetReport
methods.description: Signals to end load generation and retrieves the current report.

methods.name: RunGeneration
methods.description: Performs the load testing by dispatching ping calls and collecting results.

methods.name: ResolvePending
methods.description: Resolves pending ping calls, updates report based on success or failure.
